title: Elixi International SA
description: Elixi International SA is a Swiss pharmaceutical distributor (headquartered in Chiasso, founded in 2016) specializing in the global supply of both licensed and unlicensed medicinal products, including expanded access programs for patients.The company operates on a B2B model, serving hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies, ensuring quality through its Swissmedic license and robotic authenticity control systems, while prioritizing the rapid delivery of life-saving medicines.In addition to Switzerland, it has offices in Singapore.-SQL Data-Personal information of employees and clients-Financial documents https://www.elixi-int.com/
